summary: 8 backend tests passed, 6 browser checks passed. All 6 acceptance criteria in this briefing exercised.

checks.criterion: Normal User sees no records before searching
checks.name: test_tscheck_normal_user_search_privacy.py::test_blank_search_returns_zero_rows
checks.evidence: GET /api/search?q= as temp Bid Well user -> 200 {"items":[],"total":0}

checks.criterion: Normal User sees no records before searching
checks.name: normal-user-blank-search-empty
checks.evidence: Temp normal user (created via owner API, Bid Well dept) logs in via UI, Search page shows record-search-input empty, search-result-count='0 matches', 0 table rows despite department having 632k+ records

checks.name: test_tscheck_normal_user_search_privacy.py::test_short_query_returns_zero_rows
checks.evidence: GET /api/search?q=1 and q=14 -> 200 {"total":0} for both 1- and 2-char queries

checks.name: normal-user-short-query-blocked
checks.evidence: UI Search input filled with '1' then '14' -> search-result-count stays '0 matches', 0 rows rendered for both

checks.criterion: Only matching searched rows are revealed
checks.name: test_tscheck_normal_user_search_privacy.py::test_matching_query_reveals_only_matching_rows
checks.evidence: GET /api/search?q=14795569494 -> 200, total=1, item.data contains '14795569494' (Bid Well / Steve Wolber row)

checks.criterion: Only matching searched rows are revealed
checks.name: normal-user-search-reveals-only-match
checks.evidence: Query '14795569494' -> '1 matches', row contains the number; clearing query -> '0 matches'/0 rows (no stale row); switching to short query 'zz' after a match also -> 0 rows, no stale prior row

checks.criterion: Normal User cannot download or browse files
checks.name: test_tscheck_normal_user_role_restrictions.py::test_normal_user_files_list_forbidden, test_normal_user_file_download_forbidden
checks.evidence: GET /api/files -> 403 {"detail":"Your role does not allow this action"}; GET /api/files/nonexistent-id/download -> 403 same detail

checks.criterion: Normal User cannot download or browse files
checks.name: normal-user-no-files-access
checks.evidence: files-nav-link absent from nav (count 0); no file-upload-input/upload-department-select on Search page; GET /api/files and /api/files/.../download return 403 via page.request; direct nav to /files does not render files-page

checks.criterion: Normal User cannot select or delete records
checks.name: test_tscheck_normal_user_role_restrictions.py::test_normal_user_bulk_delete_forbidden
checks.evidence: POST /api/search/bulk-delete with ["nonexistent-id"] as normal user -> 403 {"detail":"Data manager permission required"}

checks.criterion: Normal User cannot select or delete records
checks.name: normal-user-no-select-delete
checks.evidence: With a matching row visible, record-select-all-checkbox and per-row checkboxes are toBeHidden(), bulk-delete-records-button not visible (CSS [data-user-role=user] display:none rule); API bulk-delete confirmed 403. Note: controls exist in DOM but are CSS-hidden, matching the 'hidden' wording of the criterion; first assertion attempt incorrectly checked DOM absence (toHaveCount(0)) and was corrected to visibility check - not an app bug.

checks.criterion: Owner and Pro Admin retain scoped browse behavior
checks.name: test_tscheck_scoped_browse.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/search (no q) as Owner -> total>0 (browses all); as temp Pro Admin scoped to Bid Well -> total>0 and every item.department_id equals the assigned dept id

checks.criterion: Owner and Pro Admin retain scoped browse behavior
checks.name: owner-and-proadmin-scoped-browse
checks.evidence: Owner opens Search with blank query -> result count not '0 matches', row visible immediately; temp Pro Admin (Bid Well) opens Search with blank query -> same non-zero browse behavior, row shows department 'Bid Well'
